mentions.name: Meshword
mentions.description: A word logic puzzle game that combines nonograms with crosswords, requiring both logic and word knowledge to solve. Development continues on the interface, tutorial, and puzzle difficulty levels.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Launched a word logic puzzle game called Meshword: https://meshword.org

It combines nonograms with crosswords, requiring both logic and word knowledge to solve. I am still working on the interface and tutorial, as well as the puzzle difficulty levels.
